title: The group chat
teaser: A year-group chat lights up over a clip of someone you know. What do you send?

pause.prompt: The year-group chat is scrolling fast. Someone dropped a link and wrote that it's a video of Jordan from class 'saying things Jordan would never say.' This run never shows that clip — only the chat around it. Don't reply or forward yet.
pause.why: A quick reply or a forward can spread a fake further than the original post. Pausing keeps you from becoming part of the chain.

save_thread.prompt: Screenshot the thread: who posted, the caption, the timestamp. Don't download the file itself.
save_thread.why: A record of the chat is enough for whoever you tell. Saving the media can copy it onto your device.

first_reply.prompt: The next three messages are 'send it here' and laughing emojis. What do you do in the thread?

options.label: Forward the link to another group so more people 'know what's going on'
Ask the group not to share it and to check where the clip came from

who.prompt: Jordan isn't in this chat. Who else needs to hear about this?

options.label: Message a trusted adult with what you saved from the thread
Keep it in the group — fire back at the poster and leave it there

template_group.prompt: If you send anything in the thread, start from this. Edit it so it sounds like you. Don't attach the clip.

resources.prompt: You've taken a next step. These organizations can help with reporting, removal, or talking to someone.
